tools.name: get_research
tools.description: Read product facts and the real progress of the first search for the signed-in account. Poll at most once every 5 seconds.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: Read the threads in Conversations: open threads with saved replies, newest first, and safe locked previews. Records that the account viewed its threads.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Read the prepaid balance, the alerts it pays for and the automatic top-up. alertsLeft is null for an unlimited account. Reading never spends the balance.

tools.name: list_matches
tools.description: List the thread conversations of the account, newest first. An open thread returns every field; a thread the account did not pay for returns an opaque id, the age, the community and the first words of the title.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: Get one open thread with its reason and per-destination results. A thread the account did not pay for has no detail.

tools.name: add_balance

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_threads, list_matches, get_match, get_monitoring_status, get_product_settings, start_research, retry_research, correct_research, refresh_threads, replace_product_website, connect_webhook · Private data: list_threads, list_integrations, connect_webhook · Public sink: start_research, retry_research, correct_research, refresh_threads, correct_product_facts, replace_product_website, select_website_offering, correct_website_facts, apply_website_review, cancel_website_review, retry_website_review, apply_product_facts, connect_email, connect_slack, connect_telegram, connect_webhook, test_email, test_telegram, test_webhook, pause_integration, resume_integration, disconnect_integration · Destructive: disconnect_integration.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_threads, list_matches, get_match, get_monitoring_status, get_product_settings, start_research, retry_research, correct_research, refresh_threads, replace_product_website, connect_webhook · Private data: list_threads, list_integrations, connect_webhook · Public sink: start_research, retry_research, correct_research, refresh_threads, correct_product_facts, replace_product_website, select_website_offering, correct_website_facts, apply_website_review, cancel_website_review, retry_website_review, apply_product_facts, connect_email, connect_slack, connect_telegram, connect_webhook, test_email, test_telegram, test_webhook, pause_integration, resume_integration, disconnect_integration · Destructive: disconnect_integration

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
